exams.name: Technical examination
exams.notes: Required for each classification or subclassification; passing grade of 70% or better. May be waived if applicant passed an essentially similar exam in another state.
exams.jurisdiction: administered by examination provider approved by the board
exams.quote: submit proof of having attained a grade of seventy percent or better on a technical examination where required for each classification or subclassification of licensure applied for

exams.name: South Carolina law examination (Code of Laws)
exams.notes: Examination of South Carolina law regulating general and mechanical contracting; passing grade of 70% or better. An individual may only take an examination in a license classification or subclassification two times in a twelve-month period and thereafter only once in six months.
exams.quote: attain a grade of seventy percent or better on an examination of South Carolina law regulating general and mechanical contracting

exams.name: South Carolina Commercial Contractors Business, Law and Project Management examination
exams.notes: Required for applicants seeking licensure by endorsement from another state under Section 40-11-290.
exams.quote: An applicant for certification or licensure under this section may be required to pass the South Carolina Commercial Contractors Business, Law and Project Management examination

interval_years.quote: All licenses may be renewed biennially.

available.quote: The board may grant a license or certificate to an applicant holding a license or certificate in good standing in another state whose requirements for licensure and certification are equal to or greater than those required by this chapter if the board has authorized an exam waiver agreement with the State.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license or certificate in good standing in another state with requirements equal to or greater than SC requirements. Board must have authorized an exam waiver agreement with that state. Applicant may be required to pass the SC Commercial Contractors Business, Law and Project Management examination and must comply with all other licensing and certification requirements. An applicant may also exempt the technical examination if they can verify passing an essentially equivalent exam in another state, regardless of a formal reciprocal agreement.

definition_quote.value: "General construction" means the installation, replacement, or repair of a building, structure, highway, sewer, grading, asphalt or concrete paving, or improvement of any kind to real property.

methods_authorized.quote: "General construction" means the installation, replacement, or repair of a building, structure, highway, sewer, grading, asphalt or concrete paving, or improvement of any kind to real property. ... "Mechanical construction" means the installation, replacement, or repair of plumbing, heating, air conditioning, process piping, refrigeration, lightning protection equipment, or electrical components, fixtures, or devices of any kind, excluding burglar alarm work.
